_comment: A 170 degree fisheye. KannalaBrandt with all k = 0 is the ideal equidistant projection; set k to
a real lens's calibration to match it. Fisheye lenses render as 1-4 perspective tiles stitched
together, so they cost more GPU than a pinhole camera; upsampling sharpens the stretched center.
DoubleSphere (xi, alpha) is the other fisheye model.
